mapper.select:
SELECT OP.*, CV.ConstrValDesc AS payTypeName FROM shopion.tOrdOrderPay OP INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM wizardn.tCodConstrVal WHERE ConstrCode = 'cPayType') CV ON OP.PayType = CV.ConstrVal
AND OP.OrderNo = #{pOrderNo}
AND (OP.PayDate >= DATE_FORMAT(#{startDate}, '%Y%m%d') AND OP.PayDate < ADDDATE(DATE_FORMAT(#{endDate}, '%Y%m%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY))
AND OP.PayDate IS NULL
ORDER BY OP.${sidx} ${sord} ORDER BY OP.OrderNo DESC, OP.PayNo ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopion.tOrdOrderPay ( OrderNo, PayNo, PayType, PayDate, PayAmt, PayFee, CardComp, ApprovNo, ApprovDate, ReciptBank, ReciptName, ReciptAccnt, ReciptDate, PgCode, PgOrderCode, PgTradeNo, State, Remark, RegistId, RegistName, RegistDate ) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, #{payNo}, #{payType}, #{payDate}, #{payAmt}, #{payFee}, #{cardComp}, #{approvNo}, #{approvDate}, #{reciptBank}, #{reciptName}, #{reciptNo}, #{reciptDate}, #{pgCode}, #{pgOrderNo}, #{pgTradeNo}, 1, #{remark}, #{registId}, #{registName}, NOW() )
